The successful candidate will understand both restaurant-level sales drivers and corporate governance requirements, ensuring every initiative is brand-right, operationally executable, financially justified, and measurable. Key Responsibilities: Brand Strategy & Market Execution: Convert annual brand strategy into actionable quarterly and monthly marketing plans that support sales, traffic, menu mix, guest frequency, and brand affinity. Campaign Management: Lead end-to-end planning and execution of campaigns across dine-in, delivery, CRM, social, digital media, PR, partnerships, local store marketing, and in-restaurant touchpoints. Commercial Performance: Build campaigns around clear business cases, including forecasted sales impact, transaction drivers, product/category contribution, promotional mechanics, margin considerations, and ROI expectations. Casual Dining Guest Experience: Ensure marketing strengthens the full guest journey, including awareness, reservation or walk-in intent, menu discovery, service moments, social advocacy, loyalty participation, and repeat visitation. Menu, Product & Innovation Support: Partner with Culinary, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain to support new menu launches, limited-time offers, seasonal campaigns, bundles, beverage platforms, and pricing initiatives. Digital, CRM & Delivery Growth: Manage digital campaigns, content calendars, CRM activations, app or loyalty communication, delivery aggregator visibility, paid media support, and performance reporting. Local Store Marketing: Identify restaurant-level opportunities to drive footfall, weekday recovery, lunch occasions, family occasions, celebration moments, tourist-indexed locations, trade-zone partnerships, and underperforming stores. Agency & Creative Management: Brief, manage, challenge, and evaluate creative, media, digital, PR, and production partners to ensure output is on-brand, commercially sharp, timely, and cost-effective. Insights & Competitive Intelligence: Track category trends, competitor activity, pricing, guest sentiment, market disruptions, and consumer behavior to recommend tactical and strategic adjustments. Reporting & Governance: Prepare weekly and monthly marketing updates, campaign post-evaluations, budget tracking, KPI dashboards, competitor reviews, and leadership-ready performance summaries. Stakeholder Management: Build strong working relationships with Operations, restaurant teams, corporate functions, and senior leadership to ensure alignment, urgency, accountability, and smooth execution. Industry exposure: Strong understanding of casual dining, guest occasions, restaurant operations, menu engineering, delivery platforms, local store marketing, and campaign execution in competitive markets. Commercial mindset: Ability to connect marketing activity to sales, transactions, margin, product mix, pricing, frequency, and ROI. Project leadership: Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns, timelines, stakeholders, agencies, budgets, and approvals without losing executional detail. Digital capability: Working knowledge of paid media, social media, CRM, loyalty, influencer marketing, content planning, delivery marketing, web/app activations, and performance analytics. Analytical strength: Comfortable interpreting sales reports, campaign dashboards, customer data, competitor intelligence, and post-campaign performance. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create clear briefs, leadership updates, restaurant communication, and executive summaries. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline. MBA or professional marketing certification is an advantage. Language: Fluent English required; Arabic is an advantage for GCC market execution and consumer communication.

With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world. For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow. Context Lead HSE Engineer-Green Line Section 1 (From Ain Sokhna Station to 15th May station) Missions/Main Duties Inspections & Compliance Conduct frequent site inspections and audits according to the project HSE plan. Monitor construction activities to ensure execution aligns with the Inspection and Testing Plan (ITP). Ensure all site functions comply with MSRA (Method Statements & Risk Assessments), PTW (Permit to Work), and lifting plans. Verify that employees are using proper, safe tools and that all goods/materials are handled and stored securely. Monitoring & Reporting Generate weekly reports detailing unsafe findings, unsafe acts, and non-conformities. Immediately report HSE incidents or deviations to senior leadership. Maintain and update performance logs and rectification status reports. Follow up on corrective action plans with internal teams and subcontractors to ensure 100% closure of issues. Training & Leadership Conduct mandatory HSE induction training for all newcomers and maintain accurate records. Lead and participate in regular Toolbox Talks and site "walk-downs" with senior management. Support visible HSE leadership by promoting a proactive hazard-reporting culture among site staff. Emergency Management & Investigation Lead investigations following any site accident or near-miss to identify root causes. Ensure evacuation procedures and protocols are updated and clearly communicated. Participate in incident control duties during emergencies and coordinate with the emergency group for facility drills. Profile/Skills 1. Educational Background Degree: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (any discipline). Certifications: Professional HSE credentials such as NEBOSH (IGC/Diploma), IOSH, or OSHA are highly desirable. Professional Experience Industry Tenure: 8-10 years of dedicated HSE management experience within the Construction industry. Systems Development: Proven track record in developing and implementing comprehensive Safety Management Systems. Risk Management: Extensive experience in conducting detailed risk assessments and hazard identification. Technical Knowledge & Skills Regulatory Expertise: In-depth knowledge of local and international HSE regulations, legislation, and industry standards. Reporting: Advanced ability to create technical HSE documentation, performance reports, and statistical analysis. Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex HSE challenges and implement sustainable, effective solutions. Core Competencies Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to engage, influence, and negotiate with diverse teams and project stakeholders. Language: High proficiency in English (written and verbal). Proficient in MS Office Suite (specifically Excel for data tracking, Word for reporting, and PowerPoint for safety presentations). Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants. Workplace Type On-site

review_candidates.title: Fresh agents
review_candidates.description: Company Description EgyProperty is a real estate platform dedicated to providing a safe, trustworthy community for buying, selling, and renting properties. The company focuses on making property transactions straightforward and secure for all parties involved. EgyProperty aims to be the first choice for individuals and businesses seeking real estate opportunities. By combining local market knowledge with customer-focused services, the company helps clients find suitable properties with confidence. The team is committed to professional support at every step of the real estate process. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in New Cairo for Fresh Agents at EgyProperty. In this position, agents will support clients in buying, selling, and renting properties by conducting property tours, presenting listings, and explaining key features and pricing. Daily tasks include responding to inquiries, maintaining accurate listing information, and documenting client interactions in company systems. Fresh Agents will collaborate with senior team members, follow company guidelines, and participate in basic training on real estate processes and local market trends. The role also involves building positive relationships with clients, demonstrating professionalism, and representing EgyProperty’s values in all interactions. Qualifications Strong communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with clients and colleagues. Basic sales and customer service skills, with an interest in developing real estate knowledge. Ability to learn and use listing platforms, CRM tools, and standard office software. Organizational skills to manage appointments, property viewings, and client follow-ups. High level of integrity, reliability, and a client-focused mindset. Willingness to work on-site in New Cairo and meet role-related field requirements. Fluency in spoken and written English and Arabic is an advantage. Relevant education in business, marketing, or a related field is beneficial; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. This position offers opportunities to work with advanced technology while contributing to scientific advancement and innovation. customer satisfaction and building strong customer relationships Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Excellent interpersonal communication skills and proven ability to build positive customer relationships Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, schematics, and engineering drawings Ability to work independently while maintaining strong team collaboration Availability to respond to urgent customer needs Proficiency with Windows operating systems, networking, and standard business software Adhere to all safety protocols and be able to work in cleanroom environments when required Physical ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and work in laboratory environments Other Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future Must be able to pass a review_candidates.title: Field Service Engineer (eMobility)
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a team member as Field Service Engineer to support our Siemens Turkiye e-Mobility service organization. What part will you play? Conducts technical and/or administrative, mainly pre-defined support activities for service operations and delivery. Processes incoming orders, inquiries and/or requests regarding products and/or services. Performs order management for assigned customers, manages and files clients' information in the information system. Supports customer remotely and onsite, and provides 1st level user support in case of arising issues. Drives complex issues and questions to respectively qualified Service Technicians or Service Engineers. Cooperates with clients and sales representatives to clarify orders and issues. Participates in investigating and resolving commercial and/or technical problems. Supports pre-and/or post sales technical product advice for development, implementation and operation of customer solutions. What do I need to qualify for this job? Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related Engineering field. Fluency in English and Turkish. Previous experience in service organizations is an advantage. Interest in Power BI, digital transformation, and artificial intelligence is considered a plus. Experience in e-Mobility sector is preferred. Valid driver’s license required. What We Offer? Speaking up Culture Respectful Workplace Being part of a global work environment Attractive remuneration package Excellent recognition tools providing spot awards Learning & Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth Leave days for parents and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family Creche allowance for mothers Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG Remote working and remote living flexibility only for relevant positions Find more benefits here Individual benefits are adapted to meet local legal regulations, the requirements of different job profiles, locations, and individual preferences. At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. As Siemens we believe physical barriers are not related to potential. Only the potential matters to us. Therefore, we look forward to receiving applications from candidates with physical barriers and chronic illnesses. We support healthy relationships between candidates with barriers and their colleagues because we believe we can create differences together. Siemens is dedicated to quality, equality, and valuating diversity and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities within which we work. We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Please ensure you complete all areas of the application form to the best of your ability as we will use the data to review your suitability for the role. Please find more information from our web site: https://new.siemens.com/tr/tr.html
